findings.individual_oversize_message: passed intact with oversized flag; not automatically split

operational_guidance: Budget a derived native visible render without modifying archived source messages.

Raw ToolPart output size and Message.estimated_tokens can overstate visible prompt content; do not automatically exclude large output-only messages.
No provider maximum context was proven here; any selected input budget is an operational bound and must retain room for schema, prefetch, tools and output.
